# uitars-mcp — Full LLM Documentation

## Project Overview

uitars-mcp is a desktop GUI agent MCP server that gives AI agents (Claude, OpenCode,
Hermes) eyes and hands on your desktop. It takes screenshots, feeds them to a
vision-language model (UI-TARS or any OpenAI-compatible VLM), and executes
mouse/keyboard actions through standard MCP tools.

Single uvicorn process serves FastAPI REST API on port 10976 and FastMCP HTTP
at /mcp. Vite + React webapp on port 10977.

## Quick Start

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/sandraschi/uitars-mcp.git
cd uitars-mcp
uv sync
$env:UITARS_VLM_BASE_URL = "http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1"
$env:UITARS_VLM_MODEL = "qwen2.5-vl:7b"
.\web_sota\start.ps1
```

## MCP Tools (5)

1. **uitars_execute(task, max_steps=15)** — Full GUI task: natural language → screenshot → VLM → action → execute loop
2. **uitars_screenshot()** — Capture desktop as base64 PNG plus resolution
3. **uitars_click(x, y, button="left")** — Click at coordinates
4. **uitars_type(text)** — Type text at current focus
5. **uitars_help()** — Inline help: tool listing, task examples, configuration summary

## REST API

| Method | Path | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| GET | /api/health | Backend readiness |
| GET | /api/status | VLM model health + configured model |
| GET | /api/screenshot | Current desktop capture (base64 PNG + resolution) |
| POST | /api/execute | Execute GUI task `{task, max_steps}` |
| * | /mcp | FastMCP HTTP endpoint |

## Configuration (Environment Variables)

| Variable | Default | Description |
|----------|---------|-------------|
| UITARS_PORT | 10976 | Backend port |
| UITARS_FRONTEND_PORT | 10977 | Frontend port |
| UITARS_HOST | 127.0.0.1 | Bind address |
| UITARS_LOG_LEVEL | info | Logging level |
| UITARS_VLM_BASE_URL | http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1 | VLM endpoint |
| UITARS_VLM_MODEL | qwen2.5-vl:7b | Model name |
| UITARS_VLM_API_KEY | ollama | API key |
| UITARS_MAX_STEPS | 15 | Max actions per task |

## VLM Providers

- **Ollama (local):** qwen2.5-vl:7b — ~5.5 GB VRAM, fits any GPU
- **vLLM (local):** UI-TARS-1.5-7B (ByteDance) — ~18 GB VRAM (FP16), fits RTX 4090
- **Anthropic API:** claude-sonnet-4-20250514 — no GPU needed
- **OpenAI API:** gpt-4o — no GPU needed
- All use OpenAI-compatible `/v1/chat/completions` protocol

## Architecture

```
Agent → MCP tool call → FastMCP (/mcp)
  → operators/computer.py: capture_screenshot (mss)
  → operators/vlm_client.py: call_vlm (httpx POST /v1/chat/completions)
  → operators/computer.py: parse_action (regex) → execute_action (pyautogui)
  → loop until finished() or max_steps
```

Screenshot → VLM prompt with UI-TARS action format → parse thought/action → execute
pyautogui action → append to history → repeat.

## Safety

- pyautogui.FAILSAFE = True — move mouse to corner (0,0) to abort
- pyautogui.PAUSE = 0.3 — 300ms between actions
- max_steps limit prevents infinite loops
- Local VLM (Ollama): screenshots never leave your machine
- Cloud VLM: screenshots sent to provider API

## Dependencies

Python: fastmcp>=3.2, fastapi>=0.115, uvicorn, httpx, ui-tars, mss, pyautogui, pillow
Node (webapp): react 18, vite 5, typescript 5.6
